data.name: Conquest of Empires 3
data.detailed_description:
Conquest of Empires 3 builds a strategy-first world of multi-civilization warfare, where cunning is the only passport, and every player can rely on their intellect to carve out their own empire in an epic sandbox.

The game integrates the core features of four major civilizations—China, Rome, Egypt, and Persia—allowing players to recruit legendary generals from each civilization and assemble their own all-star lineup. From Macedonian phalanx charges to surprise attacks by steam airships, hundreds of unit types and formations can be freely combined, leveraging realistic terrain to craft personalized tactics and easily achieve victory against superior foes.

Alliance cooperation is key to triumph. Plan multi-pronged siege strategies with allies, exploit mountains and rivers, and create endlessly shifting battle scenarios. The game features an intelligent command system that supports scheduled marches and 24/7 automated combat—troops advance automatically, resources are collected autonomously, allowing players to dominate the battlefield without exhausting grind.

The game adheres to the principle of fair, privilege-free competition: all players start on an equal footing, and victory depends solely on tactical coordination and on-the-spot command. A wealth of free premium currency channels is fully accessible, with steady rewards from main quests, world exploration, and conquests of famous cities. In the first season alone, over 10,000 premium currency tokens are available to fuel your growth.

Step into this magnificent theater of war, let strategy decide the outcome, and let strength build your legacy. Come to Conquest of Empires 3 and write your own civilization's epic!
